name: Diputación Foral de Bizkaia, INSPIRE Buildings (ATOM, per municipality)
license: Open data of the foral administration (INSPIRE)
coverage: Bizkaia (foral cadaster: not in the state Catastro)

fields.footprint_m2: area of the building footprint polygon
fields.built_area_m2: footprint x floors_above; footprint x height / 3 where the floors are missing
fields.use_class: residential where numberOfDwellings > 0, else unknown (no use attribute)
